brief.text: National inventory rose 3.7% year over year to 1,159,706 listings as of September 2026, while the median sale price edged up 1.3% to $393,895. Price cuts now affect 19.8% of listings, up 0.4pp from a year ago, with 42 of 50 tracked metros seeing more price cuts than last year. The top alert shows monthly payments up at least 10% year over year in 43 metros, including Houston (+11%), Chicago (+18%), and Phoenix (+10%). A second alert flags price cuts at a 36-month high in three metros: Phoenix, Anaheim, and Myrtle Beach. The 30-year mortgage rate stands at 7.24%, down 0.08pp from last week but above last year's 6.17%. Overall market temperature is rated Cold, scoring 18 relative to its own 3-year history.
key_points: 42 of 50 metros have more price cuts than a year ago.
Monthly payments up ≥10% YoY in 43 metros.
Mortgage rate at 7.24%, down 0.08pp week over week.
